title_en: Transfer-on-death deeds for a home in {state}
title_es: Escrituras de transferencia al fallecer (TOD) para una vivienda en {state_es}
search_intent_en: does {state} allow transfer on death deeds
search_intent_es: escritura de transferencia al fallecer en {state_es}
pasar una casa sin proceso sucesorio en {state_es}

facts.claim_en: Arizona allows a "beneficiary deed" that conveys real property to a named beneficiary and states it takes effect on the owner's death.
facts.claim_es: Arizona permite una "escritura de beneficiario" (beneficiary deed) que transfiere un inmueble a un beneficiario nombrado y dice que tiene efecto al morir el dueño.
facts.quote: expressly states that the deed is effective on the death of the own

facts.claim_en: In Arizona, a beneficiary deed may name several beneficiaries, who can take title as joint tenants with right of survivorship or as tenants in common, among other forms.
facts.claim_es: En Arizona, una escritura de beneficiario puede nombrar a varios beneficiarios, que pueden recibir la propiedad como copropietarios con derecho de supervivencia o en copropiedad, entre otras formas.
facts.quote: A beneficiary deed may designate multiple grantees who take title as joint tenants with right of survivorship, tenants in common

facts.claim_en: In Arizona, if the beneficiary deed names a backup beneficiary, it must state the condition under which that person would receive the property.
facts.claim_es: En Arizona, si la escritura de beneficiario nombra a un beneficiario suplente, debe indicar la condición bajo la cual esa persona recibiría la propiedad.
facts.quote: If the beneficiary deed designates a successor grantee beneficiary, the deed shall state the condition on which the interest of the successor grantee beneficiary would vest.

facts.claim_en: DC allows a person to pass real property to one or more beneficiaries at death with a transfer on death deed.
facts.claim_es: DC permite que una persona deje bienes inmuebles a uno o más beneficiarios al morir mediante una escritura de transferencia al fallecer.
facts.quote: An individual may transfer property to one or more beneficiaries effective at the transferor's death by a transfer on death deed.

facts.claim_en: In DC, a transfer on death deed must be recorded with the Office of Recorder of Deeds before the owner dies.
facts.claim_es: En DC, la escritura de transferencia al fallecer debe registrarse en la Oficina del Registrador de Escrituras antes de que muera el dueño.
facts.quote: A transfer on death deed shall be recorded before the transferor's death in the Office of Recorder of Deeds.

facts.claim_en: In DC, the deed must state that the transfer to the beneficiary happens at the owner's death.
facts.claim_es: En DC, la escritura debe indicar que la transferencia al beneficiario ocurre al morir el dueño.
facts.quote: A transfer on death deed shall state that the transfer to the designated beneficiary is to occur at the transferor's death.

facts.claim_en: In Illinois, a transfer on death instrument must be recorded with the county recorder before the owner's death.
facts.claim_es: En Illinois, el instrumento de transferencia al fallecer debe registrarse ante el registrador del condado antes de la muerte del dueño.
facts.source_name: Illinois Residential Real Property Transfer on Death Instrument Act, 755 ILCS 27/40
facts.quote: must be recorded before the owner's death in the public records in the office of the recorder of the county

facts.claim_en: In Illinois, missing a required step makes the transfer on death instrument void and unable to pass title at death.
facts.claim_es: En Illinois, no cumplir un requisito hace que el instrumento de transferencia al fallecer sea nulo y no pase la propiedad al morir.
facts.source_name: Illinois Residential Real Property Transfer on Death Instrument Act, 755 ILCS 27/40
facts.quote: will render the transfer on death instrument void and ineffective to transfer title to the real property at the owner's death

facts.claim_en: In Illinois, a transfer on death instrument must be signed in front of and attested by 2 or more credible witnesses.
facts.claim_es: En Illinois, el instrumento de transferencia al fallecer debe ser atestiguado por escrito por 2 o más testigos creíbles.
facts.source_name: Illinois Residential Real Property Transfer on Death Instrument Act, 755 ILCS 27/45
facts.quote: shall be attested in writing by 2 or more credible witnesses

facts.claim_en: In Kansas, real estate can be put in transfer-on-death (TOD) form by recording a deed signed by the record owner.
facts.claim_es: En Kansas, un inmueble puede ponerse en forma de transferencia al fallecer (TOD) registrando una escritura firmada por el dueño registrado.
facts.quote: An interest in real estate may be titled in transfer-on-death, TOD, form by recording a deed signed by the record owner

facts.claim_en: In Kansas, a transfer-on-death deed does not need to be paid for (no consideration is required).
facts.claim_es: En Kansas, una escritura de transferencia al fallecer no requiere pago a cambio.
facts.quote: A transfer-on-death deed need not be supported by consideration.

facts.claim_en: In Kansas, the beneficiary does not need to sign, agree or even be told about the deed while the owner is alive.
facts.claim_es: En Kansas, el beneficiario no tiene que firmar, aceptar ni ser avisado de la escritura mientras el dueño vive.
facts.quote: The signature, consent or agreement of or notice to a grantee beneficiary of a transfer-on-death deed shall not be required for any purpose during the lifetime of the record owner.

facts.claim_en: Maine allows a person to pass property to one or more beneficiaries at death with a transfer on death deed, with no payment required.
facts.claim_es: Maine permite que una persona deje bienes a uno o más beneficiarios al morir con una escritura de transferencia al fallecer, sin pago a cambio.
facts.quote: An individual may transfer for no consideration property to one or more beneficiaries effective at the transferor's death by a transfer on death deed.

facts.claim_en: In Maine, the deed must be recorded at the county registry of deeds where the property sits before the owner dies.
facts.claim_es: En Maine, la escritura debe registrarse en el registro de escrituras del condado donde está la propiedad antes de que muera el dueño.
facts.quote: Must be recorded before the transferor's death in the public records in the registry of deeds in the county where the property is located.

facts.claim_en: In Maine, a transfer on death deed can always be revoked, even if the deed says otherwise.
facts.claim_es: En Maine, una escritura de transferencia al fallecer siempre se puede revocar, aunque la escritura diga lo contrario.
facts.quote: A transfer on death deed is revocable even if the deed or another instrument contains a contrary provision.

facts.claim_en: In Minnesota, a transfer on death deed has no effect on title until it takes effect at death.
facts.claim_es: En Minnesota, la escritura de transferencia al fallecer no afecta la titularidad hasta que entra en vigor con la muerte.
facts.quote: Until a transfer on death deed becomes effective, it has no effect on title to the real property described in the deed

facts.claim_en: In Minnesota, a transfer on death deed must follow all state rules that apply to real property deeds.
facts.claim_es: En Minnesota, la escritura de transferencia al fallecer debe cumplir todas las reglas estatales para escrituras de bienes inmuebles.
facts.quote: A transfer on death deed must comply with all provisions of Minnesota law applicable to deeds of real property

facts.claim_en: In Minnesota, recording a transfer on death deed means recording it with the county recorder or registrar of titles.
facts.claim_es: En Minnesota, registrar la escritura significa inscribirla ante el registrador del condado o el registrador de títulos.
facts.quote: "Recorded" means recorded in the office of the county recorder or registrar of titles

facts.claim_en: In Missouri, a beneficiary deed does not need payment and does not have to be delivered to the beneficiary.
facts.claim_es: En Misuri, una escritura de beneficiario no requiere pago ni tiene que entregarse al beneficiario.
facts.quote: A beneficiary deed need not be supported by consideration or be delivered to the grantee beneficiary.

facts.claim_en: In Missouri, a beneficiary deed can transfer real property to a trust, whether or not the trust is revocable.
facts.claim_es: En Misuri, una escritura de beneficiario puede transferir un inmueble a un fideicomiso, sea revocable o no.
facts.quote: A beneficiary deed may be used to transfer an interest in real property to a trust estate, regardless of such trust's revocability.

facts.claim_en: Missouri's beneficiary deed expressly states that it does not take effect until the owner dies.
facts.claim_es: La escritura de beneficiario de Misuri dice expresamente que no tiene efecto hasta que muera el dueño.
facts.quote: that expressly states that the deed is not to take effect until the death of the owner

facts.claim_en: In Montana, a transfer on death deed must be recorded with the county clerk and recorder before the owner dies.
facts.claim_es: En Montana, la escritura de transferencia al fallecer debe registrarse ante el secretario y registrador del condado antes de que muera el dueño.
facts.quote: must be recorded before the transferor's death in the public records in the office of the county clerk and recorder

facts.claim_en: In Montana, the deed must say the transfer to the beneficiary happens at the owner's death.
facts.claim_es: En Montana, la escritura debe decir que la transferencia al beneficiario ocurre al morir el dueño.
facts.quote: must state that the transfer to the designated beneficiary is to occur at the transferor's death

facts.claim_en: In Montana, during the owner's life the deed does not affect the rights of the owner's creditors.
facts.claim_es: En Montana, mientras el dueño vive, la escritura no afecta los derechos de sus acreedores.
facts.quote: affect an interest or right of a secured or unsecured creditor or future creditor of the transferor, even if the creditor has actual or constructive notice of the deed

facts.claim_en: In Nebraska, a transfer on death deed must be witnessed in writing by two or more disinterested witnesses.
facts.claim_es: En Nebraska, la escritura de transferencia al fallecer debe ser atestiguada por escrito por dos o más testigos sin interés.
facts.quote: shall be attested in writing by two or more disinterested witnesses

facts.claim_en: In Nebraska, making or revoking a transfer on death deed requires the same mental capacity as making a will.
facts.claim_es: En Nebraska, hacer o revocar una escritura de transferencia al fallecer requiere la misma capacidad mental que hacer un testamento.
facts.quote: The capacity required to make or revoke a transfer on death deed is the same as the capacity required to make a will.

facts.claim_en: In Nebraska, a transfer on death deed works without notice to, delivery to, acceptance by, or payment from the beneficiary.
facts.claim_es: En Nebraska, la escritura funciona sin aviso, entrega, aceptación ni pago del beneficiario.
facts.quote: Notice, delivery, acceptance, consideration not required.

facts.claim_en: North Dakota allows a person to pass property to one or more beneficiaries at death with a transfer on death deed.
facts.claim_es: Dakota del Norte permite que una persona deje bienes a uno o más beneficiarios al morir con una escritura de transferencia al fallecer.
facts.quote: An individual may transfer property to one or more beneficiaries effective at the transferor's death by a transfer on death deed.

facts.claim_en: In North Dakota, a transfer on death deed can be revoked even if the deed says otherwise.
facts.claim_es: En Dakota del Norte, la escritura se puede revocar aunque diga lo contrario.
facts.quote: A transfer on death deed is revocable even if the deed or another instrument contains a contrary provision.

facts.claim_en: In North Dakota, making or revoking the deed requires the same capacity as making a will.
facts.claim_es: En Dakota del Norte, hacer o revocar la escritura requiere la misma capacidad que hacer un testamento.
facts.quote: The capacity required to make or revoke a transfer on death deed is the same as the capacity required to make a will.

facts.claim_en: Ohio uses a transfer on death designation affidavit, recorded with the county recorder where the property is located.
facts.claim_es: Ohio usa una declaración jurada de designación de transferencia al fallecer, registrada ante el registrador del condado donde está la propiedad.
facts.quote: The affidavit shall be recorded in the office of the county recorder in the county in which the real property is located

facts.claim_en: In Ohio, the transfer on death designation affidavit must be sworn before a person authorized to give oaths.
facts.claim_es: En Ohio, la declaración jurada de designación debe jurarse ante una persona autorizada para tomar juramentos.
facts.quote: A transfer on death designation affidavit shall be verified before any person authorized to administer oaths

facts.claim_en: In Ohio, if the owner is married, the affidavit includes the spouse's statement that their dower rights are subordinate to the beneficiary's title.
facts.claim_es: En Ohio, si el dueño está casado, la declaración incluye una manifestación del cónyuge de que sus derechos de viudedad quedan subordinados al título del beneficiario.
facts.quote: If the owner is married, the affidavit shall include a statement by the owner's spouse stating that the spouse's dower rights are subordinate

facts.claim_en: In Ohio, several transfer on death beneficiaries take equal shares as tenants in common unless the owner set different shares.
facts.claim_es: En Ohio, varios beneficiarios reciben partes iguales en copropiedad, salvo que el dueño haya fijado otras partes.
facts.quote: the beneficiaries shall take title to the interest in equal shares as tenants in common, unless the deceased owner has specifically designated other than equal shares

facts.claim_en: In South Dakota, a transfer on death deed must be recorded with the county register of deeds before the owner dies.
facts.claim_es: En Dakota del Sur, la escritura de transferencia al fallecer debe registrarse ante el registro de escrituras del condado antes de que muera el dueño.
facts.quote: Be recorded before the transferor's death in the public records in the office of the register of deeds in the county where th

facts.claim_en: In South Dakota, making or revoking a transfer on death deed requires the same capacity as making a will.
facts.claim_es: En Dakota del Sur, hacer o revocar la escritura requiere la misma capacidad que hacer un testamento.
facts.quote: is the same as the capacity required to make a will

facts.claim_en: In South Dakota, the deed works without notice to, delivery to, acceptance by, or payment from the beneficiary.
facts.claim_es: En Dakota del Sur, la escritura funciona sin aviso, entrega, aceptación ni pago del beneficiario.
facts.quote: Notice, delivery, acceptance, consideration not required.

facts.claim_en: Virginia allows a person to pass property to one or more beneficiaries at death with a transfer on death deed.
facts.claim_es: Virginia permite que una persona deje bienes a uno o más beneficiarios al morir con una escritura de transferencia al fallecer.
facts.quote: An individual may transfer property to one or more beneficiaries effective at the transferor's death by a transfer on death deed.

facts.claim_en: In Virginia, the deed must be recorded in the land records of the circuit court clerk's office where the property is located before the owner dies.
facts.claim_es: En Virginia, la escritura debe registrarse en los registros de tierras de la secretaría del tribunal de circuito donde está la propiedad antes de que muera el dueño.
facts.quote: Shall be recorded before the transferor's death in the land records of the clerk's office of the circuit court in the jurisdiction where the property is located

facts.claim_en: In Virginia, the deed must state that the transfer happens at the owner's death.
facts.claim_es: En Virginia, la escritura debe indicar que la transferencia ocurre al morir el dueño.
facts.quote: Shall state that the transfer to the designated beneficiary is to occur at the transferor's death

facts.claim_en: In Washington, making or revoking a transfer on death deed requires the same capacity as making a will.
facts.claim_es: En Washington, hacer o revocar la escritura requiere la misma capacidad que hacer un testamento.
facts.quote: The capacity required to make or revoke a transfer on death deed is the same as the capacity required to make a will.

facts.claim_en: In Washington, a transfer on death deed must have all the elements of a regular recordable deed.
facts.claim_es: En Washington, la escritura de transferencia al fallecer debe tener todos los elementos de una escritura común registrable.
facts.quote: must contain the essential elements and formalities of a properly recordable inter vivos deed

facts.claim_en: In Washington, the deed must state that the transfer happens at the owner's death.
facts.claim_es: En Washington, la escritura debe indicar que la transferencia ocurre al morir el dueño.
facts.quote: must state that the transfer to the designated beneficiary is to occur at the transferor's death

facts.claim_en: West Virginia allows a person to pass property to beneficiaries or backup beneficiaries at death with a transfer on death deed.
facts.claim_es: Virginia Occidental permite dejar bienes a beneficiarios o beneficiarios suplentes al morir con una escritura de transferencia al fallecer.
facts.quote: An individual may transfer property to one or more beneficiaries or contingent beneficiaries effective at the transferor's death by a transfer on death deed.

facts.claim_en: In West Virginia, the deed must be recorded with the county commission clerk before the owner dies.
facts.claim_es: En Virginia Occidental, la escritura debe registrarse ante el secretario de la comisión del condado antes de que muera el dueño.
facts.quote: Must be recorded before the transferor's death in the office of the clerk of the county commission in the county where t

facts.claim_en: In West Virginia, a transfer on death deed is exempt from the real estate transfer excise tax.
facts.claim_es: En Virginia Occidental, la escritura de transferencia al fallecer está exenta del impuesto sobre la transferencia de bienes inmuebles.
facts.quote: a transfer on death deed is exempt from the payment of excise tax on the privilege of transferring real estate

facts.claim_en: Nevada's version of a transfer-on-death deed is called a "deed upon death."
facts.claim_es: En Nevada, la escritura de transferencia al fallecer se llama "deed upon death" (escritura al fallecer).
facts.quote: A deed created pursuant to this section must be known as a deed upon death.

facts.claim_en: In Nevada, if the owner records more than one deed upon death for the same property, the last one recorded before death is the one that counts.
facts.claim_es: En Nevada, si el dueño registra más de una escritura al fallecer para la misma propiedad, vale la última registrada antes de la muerte.
facts.quote: the deed upon death that is last recorded before the death of the owner is the effective d

facts.claim_en: In Nevada, making or revoking a deed upon death requires the same capacity as making a will.
facts.claim_es: En Nevada, hacer o revocar una escritura al fallecer requiere la misma capacidad que hacer un testamento.
facts.quote: The capacity required to make or revoke a deed upon death is the same as the capacity required to make a will.

facts.claim_en: Oregon allows a person to pass property to one or more named beneficiaries at death with a transfer on death deed.
facts.claim_es: Oregón permite que una persona deje bienes a uno o más beneficiarios nombrados al morir con una escritura de transferencia al fallecer.
facts.quote: may transfer property to one or more designated beneficiaries effective at the

facts.claim_en: In Oregon, a transfer on death deed can be revoked even if the deed says otherwise.
facts.claim_es: En Oregón, la escritura de transferencia al fallecer se puede revocar aunque diga lo contrario.
facts.quote: A transfer on death deed is revocable even if the deed or another instrument contains a contrary provision.

facts.claim_en: In Oregon, an agent of the owner may revoke the deed only if the deed expressly gives that authority.
facts.claim_es: En Oregón, un agente del dueño puede revocar la escritura solo si la escritura le da expresamente esa facultad.
facts.quote: If authority is expressly granted by the transfer on death deed, a designated agent of the transferor may revoke the transfer on death deed

facts.claim_en: Texas transfer on death deeds are governed by the Texas Real Property Transfer on Death Act.
facts.claim_es: En Texas, las escrituras de transferencia al fallecer se rigen por la Ley de Transferencia de Bienes Inmuebles al Fallecer de Texas.
facts.quote: This chapter may be cited as the Texas Real Property Transfer on Death Act.

facts.claim_en: In Texas, a person can pass their interest in real property to one or more beneficiaries at death with a transfer on death deed.
facts.claim_es: En Texas, una persona puede dejar su participación en un inmueble a uno o más beneficiarios al morir con una escritura de transferencia al fallecer.
facts.quote: An individual may transfer the individual's interest in real property to one or more beneficiaries effective at the transferor's death by a transfer on death deed.

facts.claim_en: In Texas, a transfer on death deed cannot be created by an agent using a power of attorney.
facts.claim_es: En Texas, no se puede crear una escritura de transferencia al fallecer mediante un poder notarial.
facts.quote: A transfer on death deed may not be created through use of a power of attorney.
